js.list: (function(){var es=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('div')).filter(function(e){return e.children.length===0&&e.innerText.replace(/\s/g,'')==='立即评价';});var ns=es.map(function(e){var c=e,d=0;while(c&&c.innerText.indexOf('教师姓名')<0&&d<10){c=c.parentElement;d++;}var m=(c?c.innerText:'').match(/教师姓名[：:]\s*(\S+)/);return m?m[1]:'?';});return {n:es.length,names:ns};})()
js.ready: (function(){var b=document.body?document.body.innerText:'';var has=/(立即评价|待评教|暂无数据)/.test(b);var login=!!document.querySelector('input[type=password]')||/(统一身份认证|请输入密码|扫码登录|账号登录)/.test(b)||/login|authserver/i.test(location.href);return {url:location.href,hasList:has,login:login&&!has,title:document.title};})()
js.fill_submit: (function(){window.confirm=function(){return true;};var rs=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('input[type=radio]'));if(!rs.length)return {step:'no_form'};for(var i=0;i<rs.length;i+=5){var g=rs.slice(i,i+5);var gd=g.filter(function(e){return (e.parentElement&&e.parentElement.innerText||'').replace(/\s/g,'')===__PICK__;})[0]||g[0];if(gd&&!gd.checked)gd.click();}var ts=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('textarea'));var vs=__FILLS__;var st=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set;ts.forEach(function(t,i){st.call(t,vs[i]||'');t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));t.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));});var ck=rs.filter(function(e){return e.checked;}).length;var bt=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('a,button')).filter(function(e){return (e.innerText||'').replace(/\s/g,'')==='提交';})[0];if(!bt)return {step:'no_btn'};bt.click();return {step:'clicked',checked:ck,total:rs.length};})()
